snippet.title: Steel and Spellfire | Whispered Scrolls Combat Update Trailer
snippet.description:
Bring the steel. Bring the fire. Bring them down.

Steel and Spellfire is the biggest combat update yet for Whispered Scrolls, a free fantasy MMO with skill-based action combat. Every ability in the game has new effects, sounds and animation, and Meteor finally lands like a meteor.

Play free: https://whisperedscrolls.com
Join the discussion on Discord: https://discord.gg/ERJmmVutFa

What's new
• Every ability in every combat style has its own effects and sound, from a dagger's Shadowstep to the biggest Arcana spells.
• Meteor tears open the sky and drops a burning rock onto the spot you aimed at, leaving a smoking crater behind.
• Leaping Cleave and Vault fly a real arc up to 12 m, over monsters, fences and low walls, and nothing can hit you while you're in the air.
• Backstep Shot is a backflip that fires at the top of the flip, and Blink takes you up to 15 m wherever you aim.
• The spear is now a one-handed Guard weapon with a shield. Vault is a true pole vault, and Pike Wall plants copies of your own halberd.
• Shield Throw throws the shield you're actually holding, and Hatchet Toss throws your own axe.
• Upgraded gear now looks upgraded, with finer craftsmanship at +1, ornament at +2 and a masterwork flourish with a glowing gem at +3.

Every shot in this trailer was captured in-game.

#WhisperedScrolls #MMORPG #IndieGame
